description: Validate a blueprint against the live server and stage an ordered build plan. Checks Discord limits, name collisions, role references, feature requirements, and the bot's permissions, and reports every problem at once. Changes nothing on Discord. Use it for any multi-step structure, even a small one: the plan shows the user every step before anything happens. By default existing channels and roles with matching names are reused as they are. With update_existing, existing items are changed to match the blueprint too: renames (items carrying an id from export_server_blueprint), permissions, colors, topics, slowmode, category moves, and who can see or post. An item changes only the settings it lists; list one empty to clear it. To delete roles, categories, or channels, list them in remove; leaving something out of a blueprint never deletes it. Each change shows before and after, each deletion what it loses, with risks flagged. A plan that changes or deletes runs only by its plan_id, exactly as shown, or not at all.

blueprint.description: The desired structure: roles, categories, channels.

id.description: Discord id from export_server_blueprint. Matches this exact item, so a new name renames it.

permissions.description: Extra permissions per role here, beyond who can see and post (private_to, read_only, posting_roles). Example: [{"role": "Event Staff", "allow": ["mention_everyone", "embed_links"]}]. A listed role's extras become exactly these; roles not listed keep theirs.

posting_roles.description: With read_only: role names that may still post and start threads.

private_to.description: Role names that can see this channel; everyone else is denied view. [] leaves only admins. null makes it visible to everyone. Omit to follow the category.

read_only.description: Deny sending for everyone; for rules and announcements.

remove.description: Items to delete, by name or id. Deletions run last. The blueprint may be empty when only deleting.

update_existing.description: Also change existing items to match the blueprint. Default false: reuse them as they are.
